pages.title: Highlights
pages.lead: Major product launches, features, improvements, and milestones across Negentro.

sections.heading: Negentro Coding Agent Plugin launches for VS Code
paragraphs: Bring persistent project memory directly into your editor. The plugin recalls prior decisions, conventions, and context across every coding session.

sections.heading: Python SDK v4.2 — batched writes and async memory client
paragraphs: Faster ingestion for high-volume workloads and a fully async client for latency-sensitive apps.

sections.heading: Project vs. personal memory scoping
paragraphs: Memories can now be explicitly scoped so shared project knowledge never mixes with a user's private context.

sections.heading: REST API v1.3 — richer filtering on /v1/memories
paragraphs: Query memories with compound filters and date range constraints in a single request.

sections.heading: Native MCP support across the platform
paragraphs: Negentro now speaks Model Context Protocol natively, letting any MCP-compatible client read and write memory directly.

sections.heading: TypeScript SDK v3.0 — full type-safe memory client
paragraphs: Rewritten from the ground up with strict typings, tree-shakeable exports, and Edge runtime support.

sections.heading: LangChain and LlamaIndex memory adapters
paragraphs: Drop-in memory backends for the two most popular open-source agent frameworks.

sections.heading: UX Pilot AI and Google Gemini embedding support
paragraphs: Choose your embedding provider per project — Negentro now supports UX Pilot AI and Gemini alongside OpenAI.

sections.heading: Vector retrieval latency reduced by 40%
paragraphs: Re-architected the retrieval index to shrink p95 query latency across all regions.

sections.heading: Negentro Memory Platform — general availability
paragraphs: The core persistent memory infrastructure is now generally available with SLA-backed uptime and per-project isolation.

sections.heading: Negentro CLI 1.0
paragraphs: Inspect, seed, and debug memory stores from the terminal without leaving your workflow.

sections.heading: Dashboard: memory graph visualizer
paragraphs: Explore relationships between memories visually, with filters by recency, category, and user.

sections.heading: Slack and Zendesk connectors
paragraphs: Pipe support conversations and team messages into memory automatically, scoped per customer.

sections.heading: REST API rate limits raised for Pro tier
paragraphs: Pro workspaces now get 5x the previous request ceiling on all memory endpoints.

pages.raw_text: RELEASE NOTES Highlights Major product launches, features, improvements, and milestones across Negentro. Sample content — illustrative release notes for demonstration purposes. All updates 2026 2026 All Product SDK Integration Plugin Infrastructure August 2026 2026-08-24 Agent Plugin HIGHLIGHT Negentro Coding Agent Plugin launches for VS Code Bring persistent project memory directly into your editor. The plugin recalls prior decisions, conventions, and context across every coding session. Automatic memory Captures relevant context from supported sessions without manual tagging. Scoped recall Queries memory.search filtered by project_id to avoid cross-rep leakage. Inline suggestions Surfaces relevant past fixes directly in the diff view. Developer preview. Available to design partners; general availability targeted for Q4. View documentation → 2026-08-19 SDK Python SDK v4.2 — batched writes and async memory client Faster ingestion for high-volume workloads and a fully async client for latency-sensitive apps. Batch API Write up to 500 memories per call, reducing round trips by 90%. AsyncClient New AsyncMemoryClient mirrors the sync client for asyncio apps. Migration guide → 2026-08-14 Memory Project vs. personal memory scoping Memories can now be explicitly scoped so shared project knowledge never mixes with a user's private context. Scope param Pass scope=project or scope=user on every write and query. Isolation guarantee Enforced at the storage layer, keyed by user_id and project_id . Migration note. Existing memories default to scope=user — update calls that expect shared project context. 2026-08-07 API REST API v1.3 — richer filtering on /v1/memories Query memories with compound filters and date range constraints in a single request. Filter operators Support for AND/OR groups on /v1/memories . Session filter Restrict results to a given session_id for conversation-level recall. July 2026 2026-07-29 Platform HIGHLIGHT Native MCP support across the platform Negentro now speaks Model Context Protocol natively, letting any MCP-compatible client read and write memory directly. MCP server One-line install exposes memory tools to any MCP host. Tool discovery Hosts auto-detect search , add , and update tools. View documentation → 2026-07-22 SDK TypeScript SDK v3.0 — full type-safe memory client Rewritten from the ground up with strict typings, tree-shakeable exports, and Edge runtime support. Edge-ready Works in Vercel Edge and Cloudflare Workers with zero polyfills. Breaking change client.memories.add() now returns a typed Memory object instead of raw JSON. Migration guide → 2026-07-16 Open Source LangChain and LlamaIndex memory adapters Drop-in memory backends for the two most popular open-source agent frameworks. LangChain Implements BaseMemory with persistent cross-session recall. LlamaIndex Ships as a ChatMemoryBuffer replacement with zero config. 2026-07-09 Provider UX Pilot AI and Google Gemini embedding support Choose your embedding provider per project — Negentro now supports UX Pilot AI and Gemini alongside OpenAI. Provider config Set embedding_provider in project settings or per API call. 2026-07-02 Infrastructure Vector retrieval latency reduced by 40% Re-architected the retrieval index to shrink p95 query latency across all regions. HNSW tuning Adaptive index parameters based on collection size. Result caching Repeated memory.search calls with the same filters are served from cache. June 2026 2026-06-26 Product HIGHLIGHT Negentro Memory Platform — general availability The core persistent memory infrastructure is now generally available with SLA-backed uptime and per-project isolation. GA SLA 99.9% uptime commitment for all production tiers. Isolation model Every memory is namespaced by project_id and user_id . View documentation → 2026-06-19 Developer Tools Negentro CLI 1.0 Inspect, seed, and debug memory stores from the terminal without leaving your workflow. negentro tail Streams live memory writes for a given project_id . negentro seed Bulk import memories from a JSONL file for local testing. 2026-06-12 Platform Dashboard: memory graph visualizer Explore relationships between memories visually, with filters by recency, category, and user. Graph view Renders semantic clusters directly from your production dataset. Developer preview. Enable via feature flag in project settings. 2026-06-05 Integration Slack and Zendesk connectors Pipe support conversations and team messages into memory automatically, scoped per customer. Zendesk sync Tickets are converted to memories keyed by user_id on resolution. Slack app Install via the Slack marketplace, authorize channels to index. 2026-06-01 API REST API rate limits raised for Pro tier Pro workspaces now get 5x the previous request ceiling on all memory endpoints. New limit 5,000 requests/min per project on REST API . Suggest edits Raise issue Next Next → SDK & Tools

pages.raw_text: RELEASE NOTES / SDK & TOOLS SDK & Tools Releases Chronological release logs, client library updates, and MCP tooling specifications. October 2024 SDK @piyapi/sdk v1.4.0 • TypeScript Bitemporal Validity Filtering & Batch Memory Transactions Added native valid_at temporal query filters, bulk memory insertion operations, and automatic tokenization for private PHI/PII redaction. Added client.memories.batchCreate() with automatic deduplication. Added client.kg.timeTravel() point-in-time state querying. Strict TypeScript types for all 8 memory operators. September 2024 MCP @piyapi/mcp-server v2.1.0 • Stdio Protocol Full 30-Tool Model Context Protocol Bridge Standard stdio transport for Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Desktop, and VS Code with 30 active tools, 3 resources, and 3 prompt templates. August 2024 Python piyapi-memory v1.2.0 • Python SDK LangChain, AutoGen & CrewAI Runtime Adapters Added seamless integration with popular agent frameworks via PiyAPIMemoryRetriever and memory synchronization hooks.

pages.title: Platform Releases

sections.heading: 11-Signal Multi-Signal Ranking & Reciprocal Rank Fusion

Session mining engine with automatic fact extraction confidence scoring.
Tenant-level namespace isolation with zero cross-tenant leakage.

sections.heading: SAML 2.0 / OIDC SSO, Legal Holds & GDPR Export API
paragraphs: Full compliance surface including POST /api/v1/compliance/export , dual-custody breakglass access, and customer-managed KMS envelope encryption.

sections.heading: Change Data Capture for Notion, Google Drive, Slack & GitHub
paragraphs: Continuous background ingestion pipelines syncing enterprise documentation into the bitemporal memory graph.
